plan_b:
Food Chain combo: resolve Food Chain, then loop a creature that can be cast from exile — Squee, the Immortal (or Misthollow-style exile-castable creatures) — casting and re-exiling it to generate arbitrarily large creature-only mana. Pour that mana into a payoff: Walking Ballista for lethal, or a Goblin-Matron-fetched Sling-Gang Lieutenant / Broadside Bombardiers chain for reach. Ignoble Hierarch and Ancient Tomb accelerate Food Chain out early; Once Upon a Time and Goblin Matron find the missing piece. The training signal is instant-speed mana math and stack management: Food Chain mana empties at end of step, so you must assemble the full kill in one window, and Hexing Squelcher / Endurance / Fury add free interaction decisions (evoke, pitch, counter-on-the-stack) mid-combo. Force of Vigor and Wasteland disrupt opposing artifacts and lands. Combo when you can generate lethal in a single protected turn.
